# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 3 Slot 86: 1750-1836 Eurasian Endgame Great War (oe_end_). Generated by gen_endgame_great_war.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Bloc Assignment Helpers (Country Scope)
oe_end_assign_bloc_a = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
			country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
			NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_a ?= this }
		}
		add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_comrade target = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_comrade target = prev }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b
			country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b
			NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_b ?= this }
		}
		add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_archenemy target = global_var:oe_end_leader_b }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_b = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_archenemy target = prev }
		}
	}
}

oe_end_assign_bloc_b = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b
			country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b
			NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_b ?= this }
		}
		add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_comrade target = global_var:oe_end_leader_b }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_b = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_comrade target = prev }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
			country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
			NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_a ?= this }
		}
		add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_archenemy target = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_archenemy target = prev }
		}
	}
}

oe_end_assign_neutral = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 3 }
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Dynamic Two-Bloc Polarization (O(1) Great Powers Only)
oe_end_pick_bloc_leaders = {
	# 1. Pick Bloc A leader: prefer W2 oe_heg2_polar_leader -> revolutionary GP -> multi-hegemon GP -> top GP.
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_leader
			country_exists = global_var:oe_heg2_polar_leader
			global_var:oe_heg2_polar_leader = { is_subject = no }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_leader_a value = global_var:oe_heg2_polar_leader }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_great_power = { is_subject = no is_revolutionary = yes } }
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = { is_subject = no is_revolutionary = yes }
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_end_tmp_la
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_leader_a value = scope:oe_end_tmp_la }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_great_power = { is_subject = no oe_end_is_multi_hegemon = yes } }
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = { is_subject = no oe_end_is_multi_hegemon = yes }
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_end_tmp_la
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_leader_a value = scope:oe_end_tmp_la }
		}
	}
	else = {
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = { is_subject = no }
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_end_tmp_la
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_leader_a value = scope:oe_end_tmp_la }
		}
	}

	# 2. Pick Bloc B leader: prefer W2 oe_heg2_polar_rival != A -> strongest non-allied independent GP != A -> any GP != A.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_rival
			country_exists = global_var:oe_heg2_polar_rival
			global_var:oe_heg2_polar_rival = {
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_a ?= this }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_leader_b value = global_var:oe_heg2_polar_rival }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
			any_great_power = {
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_a ?= this }
				NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = global_var:oe_end_leader_a } }
			}
		}
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_a ?= this }
				NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = global_var:oe_end_leader_a } }
			}
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_end_tmp_lb
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_leader_b value = scope:oe_end_tmp_lb }
		}
	}
	else = {
		ordered_great_power = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = no
				NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_a ?= this }
			}
			order_by = great_power_score
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = oe_end_tmp_lb
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_leader_b value = scope:oe_end_tmp_lb }
		}
	}

	# 3. Assign leaders, their subjects, and existing allies into Bloc A & Bloc B.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 1 }
			every_subject = { set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 1 } }
			every_related_country = {
				type = alliance
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_b ?= this } }
				oe_end_assign_bloc_a = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_b = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 2 }
			every_subject = { set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 2 } }
			every_related_country = {
				type = alliance
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_end_leader_a ?= this } NOT = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes } }
				oe_end_assign_bloc_b = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
			has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b
			country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
			country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b
		}
		global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_archenemy target = global_var:oe_end_leader_b }
			add_casus_belli = { target = global_var:oe_end_leader_b type = casus_belli:oe_end_cb_great_war years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.1
		}
		global_var:oe_end_leader_b = {
			add_opinion = { modifier = oe_end_op_bloc_archenemy target = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
			add_casus_belli = { target = global_var:oe_end_leader_a type = casus_belli:oe_end_cb_balance_of_power years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.1
		}
	}
	# 4. Invite other independent Great Powers (and Nova Elysia if settled) to choose sides.
	every_great_power = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { oe_end_is_bloc_leader = yes }
			NOT = { oe_end_has_bloc = yes }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.3
	}
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Init & O(1) 5-Theater / 18-Anchor Scoring
oe_end_init = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_started value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_on value = 1 }
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_test_force
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_force_rev_win
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_congress_sealed
	situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_balance value = 50 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_exhaustion value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_months value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_a value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_b value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_members_a value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_members_b value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t1_score value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t2_score value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t3_score value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t4_score value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t5_score value = 0 }
	}
	add_timeline_note = {
		key = oe_end_timeline_start
		show_in_pop_graph = yes
		unique = yes
	}
	oe_end_pick_bloc_leaders = yes
	oe_end_score_5_theaters = yes
}

			else_if = { limit = { location:chesapeake = { oe_end_loc_bloc_b = yes } } change_variable = { name = oe_end_t5_score add = -6 } change_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_b add = 1 } }

			if = {
				limit = { location:chesapeake = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_end_is_nova_elysia_actor = yes oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes } } }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_t5_score add = 4 }

			else_if = {
				limit = { location:chesapeake = { has_owner = yes owner = { oe_end_is_nova_elysia_actor = yes oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes } } }

			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_exhaustion min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		# Count aligned Great Powers (bounded O(1): ~8-12 GPs)
		every_great_power = {
			if = {

			}
		}
	}
}

oe_end_sit_monthly_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war }
		situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_end_months }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_months add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_end_months value = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					current_month = 1
					current_month = 4
					current_month = 7
					current_month = 10
				}
			}
			oe_end_score_5_theaters = yes
		}
	}
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Quarterly Progression & Narrative Event Dispatch (O(1))
oe_end_quarterly_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war }
		oe_end_score_5_theaters = yes
		situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
			# Theater anchor advantage shifts global balance
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_end_war_score_a > var:oe_end_war_score_b }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { oe_end_leaders_at_war = yes }
					change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = 2 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:oe_end_war_score_b > var:oe_end_war_score_a }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = -2 }
				if = {
					limit = { oe_end_leaders_at_war = yes }
					change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = -2 }
				}
			}

			# Slot 65 Imperial Entropy synergy: severely overextended Bloc A hegemon loses grip
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a
					country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a
					global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
						has_variable = oe_ent_index
						var:oe_ent_index >= 75
					}
				}
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = -2 }
			}

			# Exhaustion accrual (faster when Bloc A & B leaders are actively at war)
			if = {
				limit = { oe_end_leaders_at_war = yes }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_exhaustion add = 3 }
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_exhaustion add = 1 }
			}

			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_exhaustion min = 0 max = 100 }
		}

		# Narrative milestone events (oe_end.2, .4-.12), strictly max 1 per quarter via else_if chain
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev2_done }
				situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { has_variable = oe_end_months var:oe_end_months >= 6 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev2_done value = 1 }
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev4_done }
				situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { has_variable = oe_end_months var:oe_end_months >= 12 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev4_done value = 1 }
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev5_done }
				situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { has_variable = oe_end_months var:oe_end_months >= 18 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev5_done value = 1 }
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev6_done }
				situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { has_variable = oe_end_months var:oe_end_months >= 24 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev6_done value = 1 }
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev7_done }
				OR = {
					has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
					situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { has_variable = oe_end_months var:oe_end_months >= 30 }
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev7_done value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { location:chesapeake = { has_owner = yes } }
				location:chesapeake.owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.7 }
			}
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.7 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev8_done }
				any_great_power = { is_revolutionary = yes }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev8_done value = 1 }
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.8 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev9_done }
				situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { has_variable = oe_end_exhaustion var:oe_end_exhaustion >= 25 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev9_done value = 1 }
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.9 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev10_done }
				situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { has_variable = oe_end_exhaustion var:oe_end_exhaustion >= 40 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev10_done value = 1 }
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev11_done }
				any_great_power = { oe_end_is_neutral = yes }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev11_done value = 1 }
			every_great_power = {
				limit = { oe_end_is_neutral = yes }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.11
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ev12_done }
				situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = { has_variable = oe_end_exhaustion var:oe_end_exhaustion >= 60 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ev12_done value = 1 }
			oe_end_notify_leaders = { ev = oe_end.12 }
		}
	}
}

oe_end_notify_leaders = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_a = { trigger_event_non_silently = $ev$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_b = { trigger_event_non_silently = $ev$ }
	}
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Four Historical Outcome Resolvers (W4 Contracts)
oe_end_resolve_hegemon_outcome = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ended value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_outcome value = 1 }
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_on
	add_timeline_note = {
		key = oe_end_timeline_hegemon
		show_in_pop_graph = yes
		unique = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_victor value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_unipolar_imperium_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	every_great_power = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes }
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_victor value = 1 }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.13
	}
}

oe_end_resolve_concert_outcome = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ended value = 2 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_outcome value = 2 }
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_on
	add_timeline_note = {
		key = oe_end_timeline_concert
		show_in_pop_graph = yes
		unique = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_b country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_b }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_b = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_victor value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_concert_guarantor_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_index }
				oe_ent_add_index = { amt = -15 }
			}
		}
	}
	every_great_power = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_end_is_bloc_b = yes }
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_victor value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_concert_guarantor_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.14
	}
}

oe_end_resolve_revolution_outcome = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ended value = 3 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_outcome value = 3 }
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_on
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_force_rev_win
	add_timeline_note = {
		key = oe_end_timeline_revolution
		show_in_pop_graph = yes
		unique = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_leader_a country_exists = global_var:oe_end_leader_a }
		global_var:oe_end_leader_a = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_victor value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_revolutionary_order_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
		}
	}
	every_great_power = {
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes is_revolutionary = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_victor value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_revolutionary_order_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.15
	}
}

oe_end_resolve_peace_outcome = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ended value = 4 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_outcome value = 4 }
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_on
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_congress_sealed
	add_timeline_note = {
		key = oe_end_timeline_peace
		show_in_pop_graph = yes
		unique = yes
	}
	every_great_power = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_end_has_bloc = yes }
			set_variable = { name = oe_end_victor value = 1 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_exhausted_compromise_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.16
	}
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Slot 86 Scheduler & Fallback Pulse Entry Point (O(1) Idempotent)
oe_end_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_end_ran_m ?= oe_end_m_now } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ran_m value = oe_end_m_now }
		if = {
			limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_on value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						current_month = 1
						current_month = 4
						current_month = 7
						current_month = 10
					}
				}
				oe_end_quarterly_tick = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_end_can_trigger_great_war = yes }
			activate_situation = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ended has_global_variable = oe_end_on }
			remove_global_variable = oe_end_on
		}
	}
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- Dev Panel Page 82 Helpers (ZERO debug_log!)
oe_end_dev_force_start = {
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_started
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_ended
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_outcome
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_force_rev_win
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_congress_sealed
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_test_force value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war } }
		activate_situation = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war
	}
	oe_end_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { oe_end_has_bloc = yes } }
		oe_end_assign_bloc_a = yes
	}
	oe_end_score_5_theaters = yes
}

oe_end_dev_push_hegemon_win = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war } }
		oe_end_dev_force_start = yes
	}
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_force_rev_win
	situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_balance value = 88 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t1_score value = 15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t2_score value = 15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t3_score value = 15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t4_score value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t5_score value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_a value = 15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_b value = 3 }
	}
}

oe_end_dev_push_vienna_win = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war } }
		oe_end_dev_force_start = yes
	}
	remove_global_variable = oe_end_force_rev_win
	situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_balance value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t1_score value = -15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t2_score value = -15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t3_score value = -15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t4_score value = -12 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_t5_score value = -12 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_a value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_b value = 15 }
	}
}

oe_end_dev_push_revolution_win = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war } }
		oe_end_dev_force_start = yes
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_force_rev_win value = 1 }
	situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_balance value = 88 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_a value = 15 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_war_score_b value = 3 }
	}
}

oe_end_dev_push_exhaustion = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war } }
		oe_end_dev_force_start = yes
	}
	situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_exhaustion value = 90 }
	}
}

	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_end.90
}

}

# Dev-only standalone W2 heg2 crisis simulator (for isolated W3 testing prior to Stage merge; never called in normal play).
oe_end_dev_sim_heg2_crisis = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension value = 75 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_multi_heg_exists value = 1 }
	save_scope_as = oe_end_tmp_sim_a
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_polar_leader value = scope:oe_end_tmp_sim_a }
	ordered_great_power = {
		limit = { is_subject = no NOT = { this = prev } }
		order_by = great_power_score
		max = 1
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = oe_end_tmp_sim_b
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_polar_rival value = scope:oe_end_tmp_sim_b }
	}
}
